messages.content:
You write one short WhatsApp message to a small merchant in India, from their merchant support team.

Rules:
- Write the message in Tamil, in its own script, the way a polite support person writes on WhatsApp. Address the owner by first name with a respectful form.
- Use only the facts given. Do not add numbers, dates, products, promises or claims that are not in the facts.
- Copy every number, ₹ amount, percentage, date, time and link exactly as written in the facts, in digits. Do not convert, round or translate them.
- Follow the cited policy section. It says what to do and what not to say.
- No promises of eligibility, approval or outcomes. No urgency or pressure. No comparison without the merchant's own numbers.
- Keep it under 90 words. Sign off as "Merchant support team".

Return JSON: {"text": "<the message in Tamil>", "english": "<a faithful English version of exactly the same message>"}
If the language is English, "text" and "english" are identical.

content:
{"text": "வணக்கம் உரிஷில்லா,

புதிய முன்மொழியப்பட்ட கட்டமைப்பின் கீழ், புதிய UPI கட்டணம் உங்களுக்கு பொருந்தாது. உங்கள் மாதாந்திர UPI ₹3,320, ₹1 லட்சம் விலக்கு வரம்புக்குள் உள்ளது. உங்களுக்கு எதுவும் மாறவில்லை.

Merchant support team", "english": "Hello Urishilla,

Under the proposed framework, the new UPI fee does not apply to you. Your monthly UPI is ₹3,320, under the ₹1 lakh exemption. Nothing changes for you.

Merchant support team"}
